rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for fired clay wares, rather than the craft or the place where they are made.

example.english: I have a set of pottery at home; I bought it while travelling.
example.traditional: 我屋企有套陶器，係旅行嗰陣買嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei5 jau5 tou3 tou4 hei3 hai6 leoi5 hang4 go2 zan6 maai5 ge3

rows.note: Use this for pottery as the craft or art of making things from clay.

example.english: I’ve recently been learning pottery and made a few cups.
example.traditional: 我最近學緊陶藝，整咗幾隻杯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hok6 gan2 tou4 ngai6 zing2 zo2 gei2 zek3 bui1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a pottery studio or workshop where people make pottery.

example.english: This pottery studio has a class every Saturday.
example.traditional: 呢間陶藝工作室逢星期六都有班。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 tou4 ngai6 gung1 zok3 sat1 fung4 sing1 kei4 luk6 dou1 jau5 baan1
